description: An `else` after a statement that is not an `if` is E-STMT-UNEXPECTED-TOKEN (S462). Pre-fix `@r = "a" else @r = "b"` reached codegen with the `else` glued into the assignment; no input shape may parse an `else` and then discard it or mis-place it.
rationale: Only an `if` statement takes an `else` (§17.6.1, §50.2.1 if-stmt-logic). An unclaimed `else` starts no statement — E-STMT-UNEXPECTED-TOKEN (§34).
